logged.notes: so tired today. i also worked out without eating

thread.text:
Today: Incline tested fresh at 67.5kg and gave 7, 7, 7 — one set short of the four-to-8 the table asked for — then a 50kg back-off for 8. On a day you logged as tired and unfed, that's a fair test, not a miss worth chasing. Pull-ups ran 8, 8, 8 (24 total) in slot 2, the first outing with the +5kg back on since 10-26, right in line with what that slot usually gives. Chest fly held 65kg for 10, 10 before the third set dropped to 6, the same pattern as 10-26. Reverse fly (42.5kg × 10, 8) and the triceps pull (10kg × 10, 10, 10) both repeat their last readings.

Heart rate: 57 minutes start to end, shorter than 11-05's 78 but longer than 11-07's 42, with the average (106) sitting a touch above both. Most of the session sat in the 90s and 100s (16.8 and 14.9 min), with only 2.3 minutes above 130 — a steady, rest-dominated lifting session rather than anything that spiked, consistent with the fatigue in your note.

Trend: Lateral raise read 7kg × 15, 15, 15, not the 8kg the table called for — that's the same reading as 10-19, so it's now three sessions without progress toward the 8kg × 20 target set on 09-28's 16s.

Next session: Upper C is Sat 21 Nov. Dumbbell bench at 28kg needs 11s and 12s to earn 30kg; chest supported row steps to 20kg after 11-07's 12, 12, 12.

Question: was the 7kg on lateral raise a deliberate call given how today felt, or did 8kg just not get picked up?
